gloss: upgrading; raising in status or rank

definitions.gloss: upgrading; raising in rank or status; elevation
definitions.explanation: The act of raising something to a higher rank, grade, or status. Often used with する for the process of upgrading.

examples.japanese: ⟦{協議|きょうぎ}→協議：02635_kyougi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{対話|たいわ}→対話：12400_taiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{格上|かくじょう}げ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The discussions were upgraded to a formal dialogue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大使館|たいしかん}→大使館：01457_taishikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{格上|かくじょう}げ⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was elevated to embassy status.

examples.japanese: ⟦{支店|してん}→支店：03185_shiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{本店|ほんてん}→本店：09566_honten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{格上|かくじょう}げ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a plan to upgrade the branch to a head office.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{格|かく}→格：13147_kaku⟧ (rank; status) + ⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧ (up). Most commonly used as {格上|かくじょう}げ (with the げ suffix) to mean "upgrading" or "elevation." The form without げ can function as a noun modifier meaning "of higher rank."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {格上|かくじょう}げ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to upgrade; to elevate in rank
- {格上|かくじょう}げ⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be upgraded
- ⟦{大使館|たいしかん}→大使館：01457_taishikan⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{格上|かくじょう}げ: elevation to embassy status
- {格上|かくじょう}げ⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧: demand for an upgrade

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{格下|かくさ}げ→格下げ：20848_kakusage⟧: downgrading — the opposite, lowering in rank or status
- ⟦{昇格|しょうかく}→昇格：08369_shoukaku⟧: promotion — specifically about people or organizations moving up in rank
- {格上|かくうえ}: higher-ranked — describes someone/something already of superior rank (different reading)
